Incident Bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected on /v1/embeddings (p95 latency spike + increased 5xx) - incident id: INC-2026-0428-7 :rotating_light:

```
2026-04-28T14:01:12Z ERROR runtime: kv_cache miss -> fallback failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable
2026-04-28T14:01:12Z WARN autoscaler: scale_op rejected, insufficient capacity
```
Samir (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) scale up pool (manual), 2) route stable traffic to fallback model variant (quantized-256)

Incident Bot: incident INC-2026-0428-7 state changed -> mitigated by failover (metrics stable).
